items: 【High-Performance Intel Core i7-1255U Processor】Equipped with the latest 12th Gen Intel Core i7-1255U featuring 10 Cores (2P + 8E) and 12 Threads, up to 4.7GHz Turbo Boost and 12MB Smart Cache, this laptop delivers smooth multitasking, faster load times, and reliable performance for business, study, and professional applications.

【Business-Ready with Windows 11 Pro & 1-Year Office 365】Preloaded with Windows 11 Pro and a 1-Year Microsoft Office 365 subscription (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), providing essential tools for professionals, entrepreneurs, and students. This complete package ensures seamless productivity, workplace compatibility, and maximum efficiency for business or study tasks.

【Massive Memory and Ultra-Fast Storage】Built with support for up to 64GB DDR4 RAM and a high-speed 4TB PCIe SSD, giving you exceptional power to handle large files, data-heavy projects, or multiple applications simultaneously while providing ample storage for documents, photos, and media without compromise.

【Versatile Connectivity & Ports】Equipped with 1x USB Type-C, 2x USB Type-A, 1x HDMI, HP Fast Charge AC Smart Pin, and a headphone/microphone combo jack, providing flexible options for external devices, displays, and accessories for work or entertainment.
【Crisp 15.6" Full HD Display】Experience vibrant visuals and sharp details on the 15.6-inch Full HD (1920x1080) screen, perfect for presentations, spreadsheets, video calls, or multimedia content.
